points.description: Gives the perceptron update rule applied only to misclassified points: when a training point x(n) with label +/- is misclassified (e.g. <w,x> <= 0 for a positive point, or the equivalent sign test), the weights are updated by adding eta*x(n) (or the equivalent signed form, e.g. eta*y*x). Equivalent notation, sign conventions or a learning rate symbol other than eta earn the mark.

Gives the overall iterative structure: weights are initialised (randomly or to zero/small values), the algorithm loops over all training examples in repeated epochs, and it stops when the weights no longer change (or change very little). Equivalent stopping criteria, such as a fixed maximum number of epochs or no misclassifications in an epoch, earn the mark. Mentioning convergence due to linear separability is not required.
